The food is roasted sweet potato cubes on a square plate that is probably about 24 cm across.

I count roughly 14 to 16 pieces, mostly about 3 cm across. Each piece would weigh about 12 to 15 g, so the total is roughly 180 to 200 g. Some pieces are larger, which could push the total toward 200 g.

Roasted sweet potato is about 1.0 to 1.3 kcal/g, and the oil used in roasting adds a little. At about 190 g and 1.2 kcal/g, that comes to about 230 kcal.
